description:
This 2024 Ford F-150 STX in Iconic Silver Metallic represents a truck built for those who demand both capability and contemporary styling. With its distinctive STX Black Appearance Package and aggressive design details, this truck commands attention while delivering the dependable performance you've come to expect from this legendary nameplate.

- 6 Black Running Boards
- Black Exterior Badging
- Gray Box Side Decal
- 20 Gloss Black Wheels
- Unique Sport Cloth 40/Console/40 Front Seats
- Connected Navigation System
- 2.7L V6 EcoBoost Engine with 10-Speed Automatic
- 4WD Capability
- SYNC 4 with Enhanced Voice Recognition
- SiriusXM 360L Radio
- Auto High-Beam Headlights
- Front Fog Lights
- Heated Power Door Mirrors
- Advanced Safety Suite with Multiple Airbags
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control

The 2.7L V6 EcoBoost engine pairs with a 10-Speed Automatic transmission to deliver practical efficiency with an EPA rating of 18 city and 23 highway MPG. The 4WD system ensures you maintain control across varied terrain and weather conditions. With a 6,650-pound payload capacity, this truck handles substantial loads without compromise, whether you're managing a job site or hauling recreational gear.

The STX package elevates your driving experience with purposeful styling elements that set this truck apart. The 20 Gloss Black wheels complement the body-color bumpers and gray box side decal, while the six-inch black running boards provide both functional access and visual presence. Inside, the unique sport cloth front seats offer comfort during long drives, and the split-folding rear seat adapts to your needs.

Technology integration keeps you connected and informed throughout your journey. The Connected Navigation System guides you reliably to your destination, while SYNC 4 with Enhanced Voice Recognition lets you manage calls, messages, and vehicle functions without taking your hands from the wheel. The SiriusXM 360L radio provides unlimited entertainment options, and steering wheel-mounted audio controls maintain convenience.

Your safety remains paramount with this truck's comprehensive protection systems. Dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and an overhead airbag work in concert with Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and ABS brakes. The low tire pressure warning system and SYNC 4 911 Assist provide additional peace of mind.

This F-150 STX combines the rugged capability truck owners demand with the comfort and technology they've come to appreciate. When you're ready to experience its blend of power, efficiency, and contemporary styling firsthand, we invite you to visit our showroom and spend time behind the wheel.

This Colorado arrives with comprehensive equipment that elevates your driving experience. The dual-zone climate keeps you and your passengers comfortable in any season, while heated seats and steering wheel provide welcome warmth during cold months. The 11.3-inch touchscreen serves as your command center, with wireless smartphone projection letting you access your navigation and entertainment without taking your eyes off the road. The Bose audio system transforms every journey into an enjoyment, delivering crisp, balanced sound whether you're commuting or adventuring.

The Z71 Convenience Package II and III equip this truck with features that matter for daily driving and weekend getaways alike. The EZ-lift and lower tailgate reduces strain when accessing your cargo, while the StowFlex tailgate storage compartment provides clever organization for smaller items. Remote start means you can warm up the engine before stepping outside, and the auto-dimming rearview mirror adjusts to oncoming headlights automatically.

This vehicle is certified pre-owned, which means it has undergone comprehensive inspection and meets rigorous quality standards. You're buying with confidence, knowing this Colorado has been thoroughly evaluated and prepared for its next owner.

The 2.7L Turbo engine with high-output calibration delivers 310 horsepower and 430 pound-feet of torque, paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission for responsive power delivery. The 4WD system with Z71 off-road tuning handles varied terrain, while the spray-on bedliner protects your truck bed from daily wear. The Advanced Trailering Package includes an integrated trailer brake controller and Trailering App, making towing safe and manageable.

Real-world efficiency comes in at 17 city and 21 highway miles per gallon, offering reasonable fuel consumption for a turbocharged truck of this capability. HD Surround Vision, rear pedestrian alert, and rear cross-traffic braking provide additional confidence when maneuvering in tight spaces or reversing in parking situations.

This 2023 Colorado Z71 represents the intersection of capability and comfort a truck ready for work, weekend adventures, and daily driving alike. We invite you to experience it in person at our showroom.

2010 Toyota FJ Cruiser 4WD 207,594 miles
Selling my black 2010 Toyota FJ Cruiser, automatic transmission, with 207,594 miles. I'm third owner. It looks great for its age and mileage and is equipped with the factory locking rear differential, A-TRAC, and P285/70R17 Falken Rubitrek all-terrain tires.

Maintenance and mechanical work at approximately 190,000 miles:
Replaced transmission, transfer-case, and differential fluids
Front lower control arms replaced with Toyota OEM parts and aligned when tires were installed
The underbody was treated with WoolWax in 2024. There's some mild surface rust underneath, but the frame is solid.
The factory radio was replaced with a Teyes CC3 2K Android head unit featuring:
360-degree camera system with dashcam recording
Wired and wireless Apple CarPlay / Android Auto
SIM-card support for cellular connectivity
OBD-II integration
Toyota steering-wheel controls for volume, channel, and mode
New door speakers
Aftermarket tire-pressure monitoring kit included but not installed

The interior, mirror, and turn-signal lights have been converted to LED, and the flasher was replaced for proper LED operation. The vehicle comes with four keys/remotes.

Known imperfections
I want to be straightforward about the vehicle's condition:
A previous owner smoked in the vehicle, and there are a few small burn holes in the driver's seat and headliner
The factory TPMS warning light is on because one of the original tire sensors has a dead battery
The HVAC mode door occasionally clicks
Drivers rear-bumper end cap is cracked
There are normal scratches, scuffs, and interior wear consistent with its age and mileage. Other than the disclosed items, everything works great and the vehicle operates and drives well.
This is not a showroom-condition FJ, but it is a solid and very capable example with useful maintenance and technology upgrades. Pre-purchase inspections are welcome

Discover the 2018 Toyota Highlander XLE, a three-row SUV designed to handle the demands of modern family life with capability and comfort.

- All-Weather Floor Liner Package with cargo tray protection
- Rear-Seat Blu-ray DVD Entertainment System with 9" display and wireless headphones
- Navigation System for confident travel
- Power moonroof for open-air enjoyment
- Heated front seats with leather trim
- Leather shift knob and premium interior appointments
- Exterior parking camera for rear visibility
- All-wheel drive for year-round traction
- 3.5L V6 engine with 8-speed automatic transmission
- Remote keyless entry and power liftgate
- Front dual zone automatic climate control with rear air conditioning
- Electronic stability control and traction control
- SiriusXM satellite radio with CD player and 6 speakers

The Highlander's spacious three-row layout accommodates up to eight passengers, making it ideal for families who value flexibility and room. Whether you're running daily errands or embarking on longer journeys, the available third-row seating expands your options, and the split folding rear seat allows you to configure the cargo area to suit your needs. The reclining third-row seat adds an extra layer of comfort for passengers on extended drives.

Under the hood, the 3.5L V6 engine delivers the power you need while the 8-speed automatic transmission with ECT-i technology manages efficiency effectively. All-wheel drive comes standard, giving you confidence in various weather conditions and road situations. The four-wheel independent suspension works to smooth out imperfections in the road, contributing to a composed driving experience.

Inside, you'll find comfort-focused amenities that enhance daily driving. Heated front seats wrapped in leather keep you warm during cold mornings, while the automatic temperature control with front dual zones ensures both driver and front passenger can set their preferred comfort levels. The power moonroof floods the cabin with natural light, and the Blu-ray DVD entertainment system with a 9" display and wireless headphones keeps rear passengers engaged on longer trips.

Safety is supported through multiple systems, including electronic stability control, traction control, brake assist, and a comprehensive airbag array that includes front dual impact, front side impact, knee, and overhead airbags. The exterior parking camera assists with reversing, and low tire pressure monitoring helps you maintain proper inflation. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide responsive stopping power.

This white Highlander XLE represents solid family transportation with practical features and genuine utility. We invite you to visit and experience how this vehicle might serve your family's needs.

- Heated Front Bucket Seats

The panoramic sunroof and power moonroof flood the interior with natural light, creating an open and airy feel.

SiriusXM satellite radio pairs with the premium sound system to deliver your favorite content, and Bluetooth connectivity lets you manage calls and music without taking your hands off the wheel. The push button start adds convenience to every journey.

Climate control is tailored to your needs with automatic temperature control and front dual zone A/C, so both driver and passenger stay comfortable regardless of outside conditions. Heated front seats add warmth on chilly mornings. The power liftgate opens hands-free, making loading and unloading cargo effortless.

Safety systems work quietly in the background. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, electronic stability control, and traction control keep you secure. Multiple airbags, including front and side impact protection, provide comprehensive coverage. The low tire pressure warning system and emergency communication through VW Car-Net add extra layers of protection.

With 59,870 miles, this Tiguan has been well-maintained and is ready for the next chapter of ownership. The four-wheel independent suspension handles bumps smoothly, while speed-sensing steering adapts to your driving style. Come see this capable SUV in person and experience the quality Volkswagen offers.

description:
This 2024 GMC Yukon XL AT4 in Black delivers commanding presence and capable performance for those who demand more from their full-size SUV.

- Second row power-release bucket seats
- Dual-pane power panoramic sunroof with express open/close
- Technology Package with HD Surround Vision and Head-Up Display
- Max Trailering Package with ProGrade Trailering System
- EcoTec3 6.2L V8 engine with 420 hp and 460 lb-ft of torque
- Magnetic Ride Control suspension with adaptive damping
- Bose 9-speaker audio system with SiriusXM 360L
- Heated and ventilated perforated leather front seats
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Heated steering wheel with memory functions
- Automatic Emergency Braking with Front Pedestrian Braking
- Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning
- Rear Pedestrian Alert and Trailer Side Blind Zone Alert
- 20-inch machined aluminum wheels
- One-owner Carfax with 30-day limited warranty

The AT4 trim combines rugged capability with refined comfort. Its muscular EcoTec3 V8 delivers responsive power while the 10-speed automatic transmission ensures smooth, efficient operation. The Magnetic Ride Control suspension adapts to road conditions in real time, maintaining stability whether you're navigating city streets or exploring unpaved terrain.

Inside, the cabin showcases genuine leather seating with heating and ventilation for all-weather comfort. The heated steering wheel and dual-zone climate control work together to keep driver and passengers comfortable year-round. Power windows, mirrors, and the programmable rear liftgate add convenience to everyday driving.

Safety and visibility stand out as key strengths. The Technology Package brings a 15-inch head-up display, HD surround vision, and rear pedestrian alert into view. Automatic emergency braking, front pedestrian braking, and lane-keep assist provide active protection, while the comprehensive airbag system protects occupants in multiple impact scenarios.

For those towing, the Max Trailering Package equips this Yukon XL with the ProGrade Trailering System, integrated trailer brake controller, and extra-capacity cooling to handle demanding tasks confidently. The electric-sliding rear window and roof-mounted luggage rack further support versatile loading.

This non-smoker vehicle represents a thoughtful purchase decision backed by comprehensive history and a manufacturer-backed warranty. Whether you prioritize the commanding ride height, genuine capability, or the refinement that befits a premium SUV, this Yukon XL AT4 warrants a serious look. Visit us to take it for a test drive and experience the blend of power, comfort, and technology firsthand.

The Active trim provides thoughtful comfort features designed for your daily convenience. Practical features enhance every journey. The Ford Split Gate splits independently, and integrated trailer brake control supports towing operations with confidence. Multiple USB ports including Type-C options in the cargo area keep devices charged on road trips. The 110V/400W AC power outlet powers laptops and devices, while the wireless charging pad eliminates cable clutter in the media hub.

- Back-up camera for enhanced visibility during truck operations

- Power windows with driver express up/down function

The Work Truck configuration prioritizes durability and function, featuring a rugged Durabed pickup bed designed to withstand demanding jobsite use. Skid plate protection on critical undercarriage components including the oil pan, front axle, and transfer case adds an extra layer of security against the hazards of rough terrain and challenging work environments.

The truck's powertrain combines proven performance with practical features. The 6.6L V8 paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission provides the strong pulling capability and control needed for heavy-duty applications. Four-wheel drive with a 2-speed electronic shift transfer case ensures you can navigate varied terrain with confidence and precision.

Work-focused convenience features enhance productivity on the job. Dual 120-volt power outlets one on the instrument panel and one in the bed let you power tools, chargers, and equipment directly from the truck. Heated power-adjustable mirrors with manual extending and folding make positioning easier during towing or backing. The power lock and release tailgate streamlines loading and unloading while reducing physical strain during long workdays.

Inside the cab, essential comfort and control features support long days on the road. Power windows with driver express functionality, steering wheel-mounted cruise control, and air conditioning provide practical comfort without sacrificing the truck's work-ready character. The infotainment system includes AM/FM radio with Chevrolet Infotainment 3, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, and Bluetooth connectivity so you stay connected safely while driving.

Safety and visibility receive proper attention throughout the design. Electronic stability control and traction control help maintain grip and direction in challenging conditions. Dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and an overhead airbag system provide comprehensive occupant protection. A back-up camera gives you clear visibility when reversing, critical for precision maneuvering in tight jobsites or congested areas.

This Silverado 3500HD Work Truck represents a straightforward, well-equipped platform ready to support your work demands. With its proven engine, reinforced underbody protection, and functional feature set, it's built to deliver the performance and dependability a professional expects.

- Panoramic power sunroof with dual-pane design
- Premium Package with Max Trailering Package
- Adaptive Cruise Control with enhanced display and alert systems
- Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium System with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Bose 10-speaker surround sound audio with SiriusXM satellite radio

Inside, you'll find genuine perforated leather seating surfaces throughout the cabin, creating an upscale environment for all three rows of passengers. The front bucket seats deliver individualized comfort with memory settings, while the power-folding third-row bench seats maximize versatility for cargo or additional passengers.

Technology integration defines this vehicle's capability. The 15-inch diagonal multi-color head-up display keeps essential information within your line of sight, while the navigation system combined with the Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium interface ensures seamless connectivity. Remote start, universal home remote, and smartphone integration through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto put modern convenience at your fingertips.

The EcoTec3 5.3L V8 engine paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission delivers the power needed for real-world driving. With 4WD capability and the 2-speed active electronic AutoTrac transfer case, you maintain control in varying conditions. The advanced trailering system, integrated trailer brake controller, and hitch guidance make towing straightforward, while front and rear park assist systems simplify maneuvering this full-size frame.

Safety technology runs throughout the vehicle. Enhanced automatic emergency braking, dual front impact airbags, and side impact protection work alongside the electronic stability control system. Rear pedestrian alert, rear cross traffic alert, and the HD surround vision camera system provide comprehensive awareness around the vehicle, while the safety alert seat adds another layer of collision avoidance capability.

This Suburban Premier combines practical functionality with genuine luxury appointments. The dual-zone climate control with front and rear air conditioning ensures comfort for all passengers, while the heated steering wheel and rain-sensing wipers address real-world conditions. With the Max Trailering Package and its supporting technologies, this vehicle adapts to your demands whether you're navigating daily commutes or weekend adventures.

Oklahoma City's local INFINITI dealer, Bob Moore INFINITI, is here for all your auto needs. We serve all the Oklahoma City metro including Oklahoma City, Edmond, Moore, Norman, and more. If you're looking for a local car dealership that offers new INFINITIs, used vehicles of all makes and models, exceptional service, and multiple finance options we've got you covered. Looking for used vehicles for sale in Oklahoma City? At Bob Moore INFINITI we have a large assortment of used vehicles including a variety of makes and models. While we carry many used makes and models, we also carry used INFINITIs in case you aren't looking for new models. If you're still trying to decide which model and trim is the best fit, we can get you with one of our certified INFINITI specialists to go over all the details - whether it's regarding features, warranties, service, financing, or any other areas you'd like addressed. Our dealership also offers a variety of amenities, free Wi-Fi, and all kinds of perks. For those wishing to shop for their car online, we can help you with that as well. All our inventory is held on our website where you can complete the whole purchase process. If you'd like to visit the dealership but need assistance getting there, we offer free valet service within 30 minutes of our store and give free at-home delivery. If you need to schedule any of these services, please call our dealership.
When buying an used vehicle, we want to make sure you get your money's worth. To ensure this, we put all our used vehicles through a service reconditioning process. This process includes a 106-point inspection of the vehicle to ensure that it's up to our standards. We make sure the tires have three 30-second tire depths or 30%, if they don't, we'll replace the tires. We'll also replace any brakes over 3mm. After the vehicles full inspection, it leaves the shop and goes through cosmetic refurbishing where we inspect and replace scratches, dents, scuffs, and road rash, as well as interior leather and upholstery reconditioning. While we work hard to ensure the quality of all used vehicles, we must acknowledge that some will end up with defects. Speak with one of our sales specialists about an used vehicle you're interested in to get a history of the car. Bob Moore also covers all your INFINITI, and any other make or model, service needs with our factory trained technicians, including 4 master certified technicians. This includes a complimentary car wash and vacuum with every service. Prior to your service, contact our dealership team to get your service appointment set up. Financing a vehicle purchase can be a stressful process but Bob Moore INFINITI offers a seamless auto financing, with over 20 lenders to work with. This helps us ensure that we're getting you the best deal possible for your new car. If you have any questions when going through the financing, don't stress. We'll have our INFINITI finance expert there with you to answer any questions or concerns you might have. Do you need to trade in your current vehicle? We buy cars too. Whether it's a trade-in for a new purchase or just simply selling your vehicle, we'd love to work with you.

Navigation comes built-in, and dual USB ports including Type-C connections ensure your devices stay charged. Wireless phone projection adds convenience without cables.

Safety features throughout this Sierra focus on driver confidence and protection. Forward collision alert, automatic emergency braking, and lane keep assist work together actively. The backup camera with hitch guidance simplifies parking and trailer hookup, while lane departure warning keeps you aware of lane position. The comprehensive airbag system and electronic stability control provide foundational protection.

This Elevation has a clean vehicle history report and arrives as a local trade-in, representing straightforward truck ownership. At 57,398 miles, it remains well within its prime. Schedule your test drive today and experience how this Sierra delivers the truck capability and thoughtful features you're looking for.

Discover the practical sophistication of this 2027 Kia Seltos S in Blue, a compact crossover designed to deliver reliable performance and everyday capability without compromise.

- 2.0L I4 MPI engine with AWD for confident handling in all conditions
- CVT transmission for smooth, efficient power delivery
- Apple CarPlay & Android Auto for seamless smartphone integration
- Rear backup camera for added safety and convenience
- Power driver seat with telescoping steering wheel for customized comfort
- 18" alloy wheels with machined finish for polished appearance
- Fully automatic headlights with delay-off function
- SiriusXM satellite radio with 6 speakers
- Climate control with air conditioning and rear window defroster
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control for confident driving
- Dual front impact airbags plus dual front side impact airbags
- Four-wheel independent suspension for responsive handling
- Remote keyless entry and security system

This Seltos S balances efficiency with everyday usability. The 2.0L inline-four engine delivers 26 mpg in the city and 30 mpg on the highway, making it well-suited for both commuting and weekend drives. All-wheel drive provides traction when conditions demand it, while the CVT transmission ensures smooth acceleration without the stepped feel of traditional automatics.

Step inside and find a thoughtfully designed cabin that prioritizes both function and comfort. The front bucket seats feature cloth trim and come with a power-adjustable driver's seat for finding your ideal position. A telescoping and tilt steering wheel, split-folding rear seat, and split cargo storage give you flexibility for passengers and cargo. The center armrest and illuminated entry add practical refinement to daily driving.

Safety and connectivity round out the package. Dual front impact airbags work alongside dual front side impact airbags, overhead airbags, and rear side impact airbags to help protect occupants. ABS brakes, four-wheel disc brakes, and electronic stability control provide stopping power and directional stability. The 911 Connect emergency communication system offers peace of mind, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keep you connected through your smartphone.

The exterior presents a clean, modern profile with body-color bumpers, heated power door mirrors with turn signal indicators, a sporty spoiler, and that striking blue paint. The rear window wiper and variably intermittent front wipers ensure clear visibility in changing weather, while fully automatic headlights with delay-off convenience handle lighting automatically.

We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this Seltos S in person and discover how its combination of practical features, reliable engineering, and everyday comfort can fit seamlessly into your life.

This vehicle presents with an accident-free Carfax history, low mileage reflecting careful use, and a non-smoker background that preserves interior condition. The 30-day limited warranty provides additional confidence as you transition into ownership.

Discover the 2026 Nissan Kicks SR, a compact crossover that combines practical design with modern conveniences to enhance your daily driving experience.

- 2-Tone Paint with Splash Guards
- Cold Weather Package with Heated Front Seats, Rear Floor Heater Ducts, and Heated Mirrors
- SR Premium Package featuring Bose 10-Speaker Audio System with Driver and Passenger Headrest Speakers

The 2026 Kicks SR is equipped with a 2.0L DOHC engine paired with a CVT with Xtronic transmission and available all-wheel drive, delivering an estimated 27 city MPG and 34 highway MPG. This balance of efficiency and capability ensures you spend less time at the pump while maintaining responsive performance on various road conditions.

Climate control takes priority in this model through the Cold Weather Package, which includes heated front seats that warm passengers during frigid mornings, rear floor heater ducts that extend comfort throughout the cabin, and heated mirrors that clear frost automatically. The heated steering wheel adds another layer of personal comfort that makes winter driving more pleasant.

This 2024 Buick Encore GX Sport Touring delivers refined styling and practical functionality in a compact SUV designed for today's driver.

Safety features provide reassurance for you and your passengers. The comprehensive airbag system, electronic stability control, and traction management work together to support confident driving. The OnStar emergency communication system adds another layer of protection and connected convenience.

Exterior touches emphasize the Sport Touring's character: 18-inch gloss black aluminum wheels, heated power mirrors, and fully automatic headlights with a convenient delay-off function. The rear window wiper and variably intermittent front wipers ensure clear visibility in any weather condition.

This vehicle comes to you as a one-owner car from a non-smoker, backed by a clear Carfax history. The Encore GX Sport Touring welcomes you to experience capable, efficient driving wrapped in contemporary design.

Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS ensure strong, consistent stopping power.

The removable black 3-piece hard top offers weather protection with rear window defrosting and wiper capability, while the included Freedom Panel Storage Bag accommodates removal accessories. Power steering, speed control, and the normal duty suspension setup round out the practical feature set. This 2027 INFINITI QX80 LUXE 4WD in Silver delivers the commanding presence and refined capability you expect from a premium three-row luxury SUV, with just 5 miles on the odometer.

- Keyless Access with Push Button Start
- ProPilot Assist 2.1
- Klipsch Premium Audio System with 14 Speakers
- Google Built-in Navigation System
- Power Moonroof
- 22" Aluminum Alloy Wheels
- Climate Controlled Front Bucket Seats with Ventilation
- Power Liftgate
- Radiant Illuminated Kick Plates with 64-Color Ambient Lighting
- Auto High-beam Headlights with Rain Sensing Wipers
- Heated and Ventilated Front Seats
- Heads-Up Display
- Premium Paint
- SiriusXM with 360L
- Rear Air Conditioning with Dual Zone Automatic Temperature Control

The QX80 LUXE 4WD seats up to eight passengers across three rows, with a flexible third-row bench configuration and split-folding rear seats that adapt to your cargo needs. Front bucket seats feature climate control with heating and ventilation, while power adjustment with memory settings ensures personalized comfort for the driver and front passenger. The heated steering wheel and rear seats provide additional comfort during colder months.

Technology integration enhances every drive with Google Built-in navigation, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, and the Klipsch Premium Audio System delivering studio-quality sound through fourteen speakers. The Heads-Up Display projects critical information directly into your line of sight, while the auto-dimming rearview mirror and comprehensive lighting package including fully automatic headlights, turn signal indicator mirrors, and illuminated entry enhance visibility and convenience.

Safety systems work proactively to protect your family, including ProPilot Assist 2.1, active cruise control, adaptive suspension, and electronic stability with traction control. Four-wheel independent suspension and front and rear anti-roll bars provide composed handling, while four-wheel disc brakes with ABS and brake assist deliver responsive stopping power. A comprehensive airbag system, occupant sensing technology, and the INFINITI InTouch emergency communication system add multiple layers of protection.

The 3.5L V6 engine paired with a 9-speed automatic transmission and 4WD capability provides the power and confidence you need while delivering 16 city and 19 highway mpg. This is a vehicle built for those who refuse to compromise on luxury, space, or capability.

We invite you to visit our showroom and take command of this exceptional QX80 LUXE 4WD. Our team is ready to discuss ownership options and answer any questions you have about this stunning new addition to our inventory.

This 2024 Ford F-250SD Lariat in gray represents a premium truck built for serious work and refined daily driving. With just over 9,500 miles, this one-owner vehicle has been meticulously maintained and arrives with a clean Carfax report, giving you confidence in its condition and history.

- 6.7L High Output Power Stroke V8 Diesel with 10-Speed Automatic and 4WD
- Sport Appearance Package with 20 dark carbonized gray wheels, black tow hooks, and matte black grille
- Lariat Ultimate Package featuring B&O Unleashed Sound System and wireless charging
- Intelligent Adaptive Cruise Control with lane centering and speed sign recognition
- Pro Trailer Hitch Assist and Pro Trailer Backup Assist with trailer reverse guidance
- Ford Co-Pilot 360 2.0 with Pre-Collision Assist and Automatic Emergency Braking
- Twin panel power moonroof and heated leather seats with ventilation
- High Capacity 11.6 Axle Upgrade Package with 5th Wheel/Gooseneck Hitch Prep
- Rapid-Heat Supplemental Cab Heater and engine block heater
- Head-Up Display and connected navigation system
- Bedliner and platform running boards
- Dual 68 AH/65 AGM batteries with 410-amp dual alternators

The diesel engine delivers substantial power and efficiency for towing and hauling, paired with Ford's proven 10-speed automatic transmission. The truck sits on premium 20-inch wheels wrapped in all-terrain tires, while the sport appearance package gives it a bold, modern look with its dark grille, black tow hooks, and coordinated trim.

Inside, the Lariat Ultimate Package transforms the cab into a sophisticated workspace. Leather seating surfaces, heated and ventilated front seats, and heated rear seats provide comfort through any season. The B&O Unleashed sound system with 14 speakers and a subwoofer delivers exceptional audio quality, while the wireless charging pad and SYNC 4 with enhanced voice recognition keep you connected seamlessly.

Advanced technology includes the head-up display for critical driving information, intelligent adaptive cruise control that manages speed and maintains lane position, and comprehensive safety features through Ford Co-Pilot 360 2.0. For trailer work, Pro Trailer Backup Assist guides you through reversing, and the hitch prep packages accommodate 5th wheel or gooseneck setups for serious towing applications.

The truck's infrastructure supports demanding use with dual alternators providing 410 amps of charging capacity, dual AGM batteries for reliability, and an upgraded 11.6-inch axle rated for increased payload and towing. The preparation packages give you flexibility to add fifth-wheel or gooseneck capability when needed.

With all routine maintenance current and extended warranty available, this F-250SD Lariat is ready for immediate delivery to a buyer who values capability, technology, and refined comfort in a heavy-duty truck.
